note: bounds and end state only: time is virtual in ours and real in X_ITE
xiteDisagrees: X_ITE 16.6.0 ColorDamper never goes inactive when the hue path crosses the 0/1 seam (blue to red): isActive stayed true 7.3 s after the value was within 3e-14 of the destination, because its stop test subtracts unwrapped hues. Ours measures the hue difference on the circle and stops.
scope: the intermediate values are pinned against X_ITE 16.6.0 as a curve: ours runs on a virtual clock (0.05 s steps), X_ITE on the real one (frames of about 17 ms), both measured from the isActive true event; every X_ITE sample must match ours interpolated within +-0.05 s of the same elapsed time (bound 0.03)
X_ITE 16.6.0 never reports isActive false when the hue path crosses the 0/1 seam; the curve itself agrees (documented in xiteDisagrees)
